class.name: HTMLDocument
class.brief_description: A shareable source document for static HTML.
class.description: Load an imported [code].html[/code] or [code].htm[/code] file, or create an [HTMLDocument] and set its [member text]. Assign the resource to [member HTMLLabel.document] for automatic display. Use [method create_layout] when drawing directly. Scripts that previously called [code]HTMLDocument.new().parse(html)[/code] should call [code]HTMLLayout.new().parse(html)[/code]. Each [HTMLLayout] keeps its own parsed document, viewport, and drawing state. The HTML importer embeds linked and imported CSS and records their textures and local [code]@font-face[/code] fonts as resource dependencies for export. Reimport the HTML file after changing a linked stylesheet. Imported documents include local image dependencies from all media query branches. In a selected-scenes export preset, add [code]addons/dockit/dockit.gdextension[/code] to the include filter so the exported project can load Dockit classes.

method.name: create_layout
method.description: Parses a snapshot of this resource into a new [HTMLLayout]. Call [method HTMLLayout.layout] with the target viewport size, then [method HTMLLayout.draw] to display it. See [method HTMLLayout.get_render_error] for parse or layout errors.

method.name: create_print_layout
method.description: Creates a print layout from this resource. The layout uses print media queries, applies CSS [code]@page[/code] size and margins, and exposes page geometry in CSS pixels. The default page is A4 portrait with 10 mm margins. The optional dictionary accepts [code]page_size: Vector2[/code] in CSS pixels, [code]orientation[/code] as [code]portrait[/code] or [code]landscape[/code], [code]margin[/code] as a number, [code]Vector4(left, top, right, bottom)[/code], or a dictionary of side values, and [code]page_name[/code] for named [code]@page[/code] rules. Explicit options override CSS.

members.member: The base directory in [code]res://[/code] or [code]user://[/code] used for relative asset paths. Imported resources use the source file's directory.
Additional CSS for this document. The rules share the document stylesheets' author origin and follow them in source order. See [method HTMLLayout.parse].
The source HTML document or fragment.
